items.text: We're revving up the excitement on the track with the Ver. 2.0.0 major update and Season Pass Two, now available for Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds.
*You must update to the latest version of the game to play online modes and access DLC.
Version
Duel Mode
Super Slot
Play Missions
The Shop
An Expanded World Match Experience
Changes to Festivals
15 New Gadgets
Competitive Balance Adjustments
Gadget Adjustments
Time Trial Gadget Adjustments
Other Content Additions
Other Updates
Fixed other minor bugs.
Issues in Ver. 2.0
PS5 / PS4 : Ver.2.0.0
Nintendo Switch / Nintendo Switch 2 : Ver.2.0.0
Xbox Series X|S / Xbox One : Ver.2.0.0
Steam : Ver.2.0.0
Epic : Ver.2.0.0
Welcome to the next stage of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds!
After an exciting World Championship, we're going full throttle into Year Two.
The Ver. 2.0 update adds Duel Mode and the Super Slot to the game.
On top of that, we're dropping 6 Premium DLC packs and 8 free updates throughout the year.
Stay tuned to see what's coming out of the garage next.
We hope you continue to support Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds through all the high-octane fun coming in Year Two.
Duels let you take on other racers in 1-on-1 showdowns.
This mode can be played both offline and online.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/4610eb134b68210894e2f9e3ccb173224161c52b.jpg"]
While racing, you'll have an extra ace up your sleeve: Duel Boost.
This gauge fills up as time passes and you use items.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/d3bc40a1a8f955d45fd392e9c6cc4549df803b1f.gif"]
Once it's full, press the button to boost ahead.
Time your Duel Boost well to pull off clutch comebacks!
Face off against CPU CrossOver racers in offline 1-on-1 matches.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/6b9e2b5e53036a0f467da4c025a2a1cf25016990.jpg"]
By defeating these powerful rivals, you'll earn unique rewards.
Keep on progressing to unlock the new racer Bayonetta!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/00cd4e313eaabb879346f54f6c81aa5d371acf59.jpg"]
Test your skills in a 1-on-1 match against players worldwide.
Give it everything you've got in an adrenaline-pumping race where it's just you, your opponent, and the track.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/f82a75fc1a5467f0f1c2466602ab1e8584e276e0.jpg"]
Compete for the most points within a limited number of races.
Join these limited-time events and earn Duel Medals.
Exchange them for exclusive horns, auras, and other rewards!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/4043538c7fbf98f02ad7285ee4d8ed2779d66781.jpg"]
Face off against a friend or family member with this Friend Match option.
*On Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2, you can play this mode in Local Wireless.
7th Gadget Slot added
The Super Slot amplifies the effects of your Gadgets.
*To use the Super Slot, you must first unlock the Grand Master Plate by racing at least 40 times.
Players who have already fulfilled these conditions will be able to use the Super Slot upon installing the patch.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/8e461eed14299873f7938fd887dd451c5853752f.jpg"]
We're adding various missions that you can complete by playing regularly.
Clear them by the deadline to earn Donpa Tickets and Duel Medals.
*You must be connected to the Internet to participate in Play Missions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/4c193abc639df911fb9a2d8f5abeb6f808ba1c77.jpg"]
Exchange your Donpa Tickets and Duel Medals for auras, horns, decals, characters, titles, and Jukebox tracks at the new in-game Shop.
We'll be updating the store lineup over time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/e33b7c780763b47a0df88e60728ba4ebbb7c5399.jpg"]
Free Matches don't affect your rank, so feel free to jump in without any pressure.
*Head over to Ranked Match for the original World Match experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/985efb9ccd92107448fb11e51488047ab9c27237.jpg"]
Matchmaking will now pit you against Rivals of similar skill level.
Come out on top to earn bonus Donpa Tickets!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/09a2b56d4a1feee4562b8b34ecc270cd719ac06a.png"]
Festivals are now 10 days, up from 3 days.
There's more time to join the fun and rack up all of the Festival Point Rewards.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/02928cd1a21b3dbd192da6228d50d4fed7af043a.jpg"]
Alongside the extended Festivals, win streaks will now determine Festival Rankings rather than Festival Points.
When a Festival is live, your longest win streak will appear on the leaderboard.
If your team finishes in 2nd place, don't worry. Your win streak won't reset, allowing you to keep up your run.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/149944517d465bfa04cd72e8ec0f70018cc01df7.jpg"]
Before
1st: +1 to win streak
2nd: Win streak reset
3rd: Win streak reset
After
1st: +1 to win streak
2nd: No change to win streak
3rd: Win streak reset
AI Rival teams can now appear in your matches at random.
Defeating them earns you bonus Festival Points!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/4023ec567040d032ed8da73ddaf532571741c6f5.jpg"]
Win even more crowns while playing Festivals!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/bc774704de611eab672964735f7ea86ea0509a8b.png"]
Red Crown
Given to all players on the 1st-place team.
Also given to the top player on each of the 2nd- and 3rd-place teams.
Blue Crown
Even more prestigious than the Red Crown. Given to the MVP of the 1st-place team.
During the Godzilla Festival, the player with the most Rule Points on the top team gets the Blue Crown.
Gold Crown
Awarded to players who have a 5+ win streak.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/5d7c2f2fd7d69755f845bf7dc4f729eba3a9e75e.jpg"]
15 new Gadgets added.
*These can be obtained once your Gadget Plate reaches Grand Master Plate or higher.
Hit and Run

Refined Counter Drift
Speed Mod

notes.title: Previous Festival rewards added to the Shop

items.text: The following Gadgets, previously distributed as Festival rewards, can now be purchased with Donpa Tickets from the Customize Gadgets screen.
*These can be purchased once your Gadget Plate reaches Master Plate or higher.
Speedy Shortcut Kit
Perfect Charge Kit
4th Stage Charge Kit
Air Trick Action Kit
Slipstream Kit
Spin Dash Kit
Super Slot added: powering up the Gadget system
The Super Slot, the 7th Gadget slot, gives players even more ways to customize their racing strategy.
Alongside this addition, we've adjusted underpowered and overpowered Gadgets.
We've also introduced 1-slot variants of existing Gadgets that are compatible with the Super Slot.
To add more ways to drive, the update adds Mod Gadgets, which offer bigger stat bonuses than existing Tuner Gadgets, and the new Charge Gadgets.
Plus, we've adjusted the overall balance, shortening the time it takes Rings to spawn and buffing Acceleration Type Machines.
These changes will give racers in the middle of the pack chances to stage a comeback.
Going forward, more Gadget and Machine adjustments will be made to create a better player and competitive experience.
Rings now take less time to respawn after players collect them.
In Ver. 1.4, it was difficult to collect Rings when racing alongside others. As a result, Gadgets that let players obtain Rings independently held a significant advantage.
We've implemented this change to give players in middle positions more chances for success.
Since these adjustments will make the Ring Engine Gadgets and Ring Evolution more powerful, we have rebalanced their performance accordingly.
*These adjustments do not apply to offline modes, such as Grand Prix and Race Park.
Acceleration Type Machines
Shortened recovery time after taking damage.
Based on usage and win rates of Acceleration Type Machines, we have made adjustments to improve their signature trait of recovering quickly.
They should excel on courses with many enemies and obstacles, as well as in races where attacks are frequent.
Fixed an issue where Power Type Machines had a higher maximum speed bonus cap than other Machines.

Originally planned for Ver. 1.4.1, we postponed this fix to prevent an issue making it impossible to update your records in Time Trial. However, as the new Gadget Slot is likely to impact records in Ver. 2.0, we have proceeded with this change.
Collisions in online matches
In online races, reduced the force pulling Machines back toward their original path after vehicles collide.
This should lessen the impact that other Machines impose on you.
Deceleration upon hitting obstacles
While Boosting from a Dash Panel or Dash Gate, Machines will no longer slow down when hitting obstacles that reduce speed without causing Ring loss, such as the bollards found in shortcuts.
This adjustment makes it easier to take Dash Gate shortcuts now that Frenzy can trigger during the 2nd lap of the Main Course.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/9d671285634aef419b8025fd2833f1e93399f6e5.jpg"]
Passing through Dash Rings
Reduced the amount of rebound when colliding with other Machines as you pass through a Dash Ring.
This should make it less likely for players to be pushed off the course in the Aqua Forest shortcuts and other such areas.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/bcd3b839eb1fe7b7273b86da69e6e2c8f2dcc029.jpg"]
Homing Punch, Slicer
The user is now immune to their own attacks.
Rocket Punch

Lowered the maximum wall bounces to 2 for both forward and backward throws, reducing the amount of self-inflicted hits and unintended hits on other players. Previously, forward throws could ricochet up to 6 times, and backward throws up to 3 times.
Slicer
Now breaks immediately upon hitting an invincible racer.
Drill, Laser, Warp Ring
Increased movement speed to account for higher average Machine speeds caused by Gadget effects.
Omochao
Adjusted Omochao's Ring placement so that Rings are easier to collect mid-jump.
Boost, Double Boost
While holding either Boost or Double Boost, the other item can now still spawn from an Item Box. Previously, holding either a Boost or Double Boost made both items less likely to appear.
Bomb
Adjusted the explosion effect to better match the duration of its attack hitbox.
Frenzy events on 2nd lap main courses
Frenzy can now occur when racing on a Main Course during the 2nd lap.
*Occurs in all modes except Time Trial.
Additional course objects
Adjusted the placement of Rings and Item Boxes to improve the risk-reward balance of certain paths on the following courses:
Urban Canyon
Aqua Forest
Eggman Expo
Wily Castle
Lion Turtle Island
Added Double Item Boxes to spots where they previously didn't spawn during the 3rd lap on the following courses:
Ocean View
Sand Road
Market Street
Mystic Jungle
Pumpkin Mansion
Northstar Islands
White Space
PAC-VILLAGE & MAZE
New York City
Dash Panels that originally only appeared during the 1st lap now also appear during the 3rd lap on the following courses:
Colorful Mall
Crystal Mine
Urban Canyon
Radical Highway
Eggman Expo
White Space
Enemy attack changes
Mutagen attacks now occur sooner on the New York City map during the 3rd lap, as they would not trigger soon enough for the racer in 1st place.
Time Trial course adjustments
Adjusted the Rings in the PAC-VILLAGE & MAZE course for Time Trial to have the same placement that they do in other modes.
Reduced the number of Tap Boosts that CPU-only groups perform, as they were performing too strongly under the Tap Boost rules.
Gave CPU racers wider Gadget loadout variety in World Match, Legend Competition, and Festival.
Since their introduction, Ring Engine and Hyper Ring Engine have maintained high win rates, particularly in Emerald Grade of Legend Competition

Since Ver. 2.0 makes it easier to maintain Rings due to the shortened Ring respawn times and the ability to equip an additional Gadget that grants Rings with the Super Slot, we've lowered the top speed bonus from these two Gadgets.
In parallel, we've adjusted Gadgets that make it easier to maintain your Rings.
Ring Engine
Lowered the stat boost from +12 to +8 when carrying 1 or more Rings.
Reduced the top speed bonus from +3 km/h to +2 km/h, and the bonus now scales with the number of Rings held.
When equipped in a Super Slot, the stat bonus is +12, with the top speed bonus scaling up to +3 km/h based on the number of Rings held.
Hyper Ring Engine
Lowered the top speed bonus from +4 km/h to +3 km/h, and the bonus now scales with the number of Rings held.
When paired with Ring Engine, removed the effect granting an additional +2 km/h to top speed.
Ring Evolution
Raised Ring Evolution's Ring requirement from 10 to 15.
When equipped in the Super Slot, the requirement goes back to 10 Rings
Perfect Charge Bounty
Lowered the Rings awarded by performing a Perfect Charge from 3/6/9 to 2/4/6.
Slipstream Bounty, Acceleration Character Kit, Slipstream Kit
Now grants Rings every 0.6 seconds instead of 0.5.
When equipped in the Super Slot, this interval stays at 0.5 seconds.
Crash Pads
Weakened Crash Pads effect against Ring loss, protecting only 30% of Rings instead of 50%. When equipped in the Super Slot, the effect remains 50%.
The following Ring Gadgets have been enhanced.
Since these Gadgets don't continuously collect Rings, these enhancements should have only a small impact on Ring Engine builds.
Travel Ring Bounty
Increased the number of Rings you can receive from 15 to 25.
Morph Action Bounty
Increased the number of Rings you can receive from 4 to 6.
Ring Thief
Increased the number of Rings stolen from the other Machine from 5 to 8.
Ring Thief was useful for gaining a lot of rings early in the race, but became less useful from mid-race onward, so we've enhanced it.
Held off on adjusting Mini Ring Thief due to its use in Ring Engine builds.
Handling Character Kit
Increased the number of Rings stolen from the other Machine from 7 to 10.
Ring Gain Boost/Acceleration Character Kit
Increased top speed boost while collecting Rings from +15 km/h to +17 km/h.
This adjustment has been made to offset the weaker Slipstream Bounty and the Power Machine issue fix.
Held off on adjusting Ring Gain Mini Boost due to its use in Ring Engine builds.

The following Driving Gadgets were useful on certain courses and in certain situations, but in many cases ended up being underpowered. We have enhanced their performance in Ver. 2.0 to make their unique abilities more distinct.
Air Trick Adept/Air Trick Action Kit
Increased the Air Trick rotation speed acceleration multiplier from 1.25x to 1.375x.
This makes the boost exactly half that of Air Trick Expert.
Perfect Landing
After a Perfect Landing, the duration of the maximum speed boost now increases proportionate to the number of Air Tricks performed.
Air Drift Mobility UP/Ace Pilot Kit
Added an effect that makes all Levels charge 1.7x faster while in flight form.
Charge Jump Mobility UP/Sea Dog Kit
Added an effect that makes all Levels charge 1.7x faster while in water form.
Collision Boost/Power Machine Kit/Power Character Kit
Increased boost duration from 0.5 to 1.7 seconds.
Damage Mercy
Extended invincibility duration after taking damage from 8 to 10 seconds.
All-Rounder Kit
The speed penalty reduction effect in deceleration areas is now 3x stronger.
Second Wind/Damage Support Kit
Will now receive a Double Boost when you fall off the course.
Acceleration Machine Kit
Shortened stun duration after taking damage.
Enhanced the Gadgets below to make them more useful in the current game environment.
Friction Drift
Charging speed multiplier increased from 1.5x to 1.7x.
Perfect Charge Boost/Perfect Charge Kit
Maximum speed boost duration after a successful Perfect Charge Boost extended from 0.5 to 1.0 seconds.
Lv1 Quick Charge
Charging speed multiplier increased from 1.4x to 1.7x.
*The previous value was lower than intended, so it has been fixed.
Tuner Gadgets (All 10 Types)
Increased stat bonus when Machine Type does not match from +8 to +15.
Summon Item Box
Reduced the number of Rings needed to summon from 40 to 30.
Speed Item Chance UP
Now needs 2 slots instead of 3.
Go Go Omochao
Increased Omochao Ring dispensing time from 8 to 10 seconds.
Comeback Kit
Increased Ring Limit from 110 to 130.
Character Kits (All 5 Types)
Adjusted stats when Character Type matches.
Until now, a matching Character Type would give a +7 boost to one stat and a -5 penalty to another. Going forward, there will be a +3 boost and no penalty.
Spin Dash Kit
Fixed an issue where the time required to charge differed depending on the timing of the button presses.
Fixed an issue where getting crushed sometimes caused the Spin Dash visual effect to stretch vertically.
Technical Drift
While there are no changes to performance, the following graphical adjustments have been made.

Due to course visibility issues with the addition of large Boost Type Machines in Ver. 2.0, lighting effects for Boost Type Machines have been cut down from the entire Machine to just the outer edges.
The 4th level Ultimate Charge lighting effect is no longer used elsewhere to make it distinct from other effects.
Fixed an issue where the lighting effects of tires such as those on the Trail Runner would flicker.
Boosted the stats for the following Gadgets to better harness their unique strengths.
Bumper Guard
+10 Power added to current effects.
Maximum Traction/All-Rounder Kit
+10 Handling added to current effects.
Hazard Item Chance UP
+10 Speed added to current effects.
Giant Rocket Punch
+10 Handling added to current effects.
Giant Spiked Iron Ball
+10 Speed added to current effects.
Short Fuse
+10 Handling added to current effects.
Boost Starter/Speedy Shortcut Kit
+10 Boost added to current effects.
Since balance adjustments can weaken Gadgets and make them less viable for setting new records in Time Trial, we may make separate Gadget adjustments for Time Trial alone starting in Ver. 2.0.
For Ver. 2.0, the following Gadgets perform differently in Time Trial.
Ring Engine
In Time Trial, reduced the top speed bonus for acquiring a Ring has been reduced from 3 km/h to 2 km/h.
*When equipped in the Super Slot, the bonus remains unchanged at 3 km/h.
Hyper Ring Engine
In Time Trial, this Gadget will have the same performance as in Ver. 1.4.
However, you will no longer get an additional stat boost by equipping both the Ring Engine and Hyper Ring Engine.
You can get the same boost by equipping Quick Starter or Starting Boost Bounty as your 7th Gadget.
Ring Evolution
In Time Trial, this Gadget will have the same performance as in Ver. 1.4, and will evolve every 10 Rings.
Perfect Charge Bounty
In Time Trial, this Gadget will have the same performance as in Ver. 1.4.

Fixed an issue where taking damage while pressing the Brake button caused rapid deceleration or reversing.
Fixed an issue where Boost effects sometimes were not visible during Boosts.
Fixed an issue where the controller sometimes vibrated unexpectedly during Super Team Boost.
Fixed an issue where the activation time was too short for the Level 4 Drift Boost during a Drift Charge Frenzy.
Fixed an issue where the crosshairs were displayed even when the Slicer hit a non-targeted racer.
Fixed an issue where the Laser would move at low speeds under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue where players sometimes fell when using the Laser while in the Shortcut Ring on the 3rd lap of the E-Stadium course.
Fixed an issue where players sometimes fell after using the Laser on the 2nd corner of the Metal Harbor course.
Fixed an issue where using a Laser or Drill at the entrance to the flight area on the Urban Canyon course sent players to the ground route instead.
Fixed an issue where, while in the flight area of the Urban Canyon course, getting too close to the ground route caused players to leave flight form and fall.
Fixed an issue preventing the Laser and Drill items from deploying on the shortcut at the last corner on the Donpa Factory course.
Fixed an issue where, if the player fell off the 3rd corner of the Chao Park course, the recovery animation sometimes looped.
Fixed an issue where the Jump Panel in front of the tower on the Kronos Island course would cause Machines to fall instead of jump.
Fixed an issue in the Sky Temple area on the Northstar Islands course where jumping would sometimes cause the Machine to roll.
Fixed an issue on the 2nd corner of the 1st lap of the White Space course where players sometimes fell while driving through the center of the course.
Fixed an issue in the 1st lap water area of the White Space course where Machines sometimes got caught on the mid-air track, causing them to roll.
Adjusted the course layout of White Space to reduce the number of players falling off the course during the shortcut at the last corner of the 3rd lap.
Fixed an issue where players would not Boost when performing an Air Trick at the entrance to the last section of the MINECRAFT WORLD course.
Fixed an issue on the 3rd lap of the MINECRAFT WORLD course where using a Laser at the exit to the last section sometimes caused players to fall off the course.
Fixed an issue on the PAC-VILLAGE & MAZE course where players sometimes fell off the course if they took damage from an item or hit another Machine at the exit to the maze.
Fixed an issue on the Lion Turtle Island course where players sometimes fell off the course if they used a Charge jump at the top of the slope in the water bending area.
Adjusted the Dinosaur Jungle course so that, if players hit the final Jump Panel while drifting, their Machine will face forward on the track instead of turning sideways.
Fixed an issue on the White Cave course where using a Drill on the jump just before the vine area would sometimes cause it to get caught on the track.
Fixed an issue where Machines sometimes rolled at the automated jump spots (orange Jump Panels) on each course.
Adjusted areas of the following courses where being knocked sideways during a jump could push players off the course.
Aqua Forest, Chao Park, Eggman Expo, Golden Temple, Magma Planet
Adjusted the following courses to prevent Machines from floating during drifts.
E-Stadium, Sand Road, Mystic Jungle, Urban Canyon, Radical Highway, Donpa Factory, White Space, Roulette Road
Fixed an issue where high-difficulty CPUs did not defend themselves against the Homing Punch.
Fixed an issue where high-difficulty CPUs did not use the Tornado to defend themselves.
Fixed an issue for World Match Legend Rank 1 where a Donpa Ticket reward that did not actually exist sometimes appeared on the rank gauge.
Fixed an issue under certain Festival rules where Frenzy did not activate on the 2nd lap of the main course.
Fixed other minor gameplay issues.
Corrected the text for certain titles in multiple languages.
For the Sonic (35th Anniversary) collaboration decal, a point reward from the Sonic 35th Anniversary Festival, Sonic has recovered the Chaos Emeralds that Rouge had taken and now holds all seven.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/37fe1428938da517ae53b211fa0b2bf03d8d40f8.jpg"]
Additional minor gameplay issues were also fixed.
In Ver. 2.0, prior to the start of Best-of-10 in Duel Match, "End Challenge" and "Round -1" are displayed.
This issue will be resolved after the first Best-of-10 competition starts.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/7fbf96c30335d9657b84c58091a2ef82445fd7b0.jpg"]
In addition, if the event period ends while a player still has races remaining in the Best-of-10 competition, "X Tries Remaining" will be displayed even though the event has ended.
This issue will be addressed in a future update. We will let you know as soon as it has been resolved.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/8430ae5c8ec65f4420dc8c1f819fca9789b1c72f.jpg"]
Thanks to all the CrossWorlds players out there for rocketing through the multiverse with us throughout the World Championship and our major Year Two update.
We’re committed to delivering new content to keep the game exciting, and will continue making improvements based on your feedback.

items.text: Thank you very much for playing Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! To provide everyone with an even better gameplay experience, we have updated the game to Ver. 1.4.1.
Note: Please update your game to the latest version to access online modes and downloadable content.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/67934ce4e84a42d0337ea23b3e4a3ff4085dc6b4.png"]*Some of the content will be distributed after a maintenance update.
PS5 / PS4: Ver.1.4.1
Nintendo Switch / Nintendo Switch 2: Ver.1.4.1
Xbox Series X|S Ver.1.4.1
Steam: Ver.1.4.1
Epic: Ver.1.4.1
This update celebrates Sonic’s 35th anniversary!
We’ve added Classic Sonic and his machine Mach Cyclone, as well as special 35th anniversary music tracks. We’ve also added new Gadgets, made balance adjustments to races, and fixed various bugs.
The World Championship Qualifier (Legend Competition Round 6) has also been announced!
We hope you continue to enjoy the ever expanding excitement of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds!
Added Classic Sonic as a playable character
Added Mach Cyclone as a selectable machine
Added Sonic 35th Anniversary music tracks
Added new songs by three artists in celebration of the 35th anniversary
*Will be distributed after a maintenance update.
Added 15 collaboration decals with famous brands
Added “Donpa Ticket Chance,” which has a set chance of occurring
Added 8 new Gadgets that expand existing strategies
Made adjustments to Gadgets and races
Added voice support for Chinese (Mandarin)
Character Friendship is now unlocked by default
Changed the CPU icon to a standard robot mark during online play
Added support for the DualSense™ Wireless Controller on PC (Steam/Epic)
Added a SEGA Account linking feature
Updated staff credits
Fixed a variety of other issues, as well as updated data for upcoming live content and the World Championship
Sonic will celebrate his 35th anniversary on June 23, 2026!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/436c75640c57a5eb47eeafb93d3f9a831b186d02.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493126/509d0edd1fce46ad82a04129c72c302bc52a5f4b.png"]
To commemorate this milestone, we have added Classic Sonic and his machine Mach Cyclone.

With Ver. 1.4.1, we’re aiming to expand tactical variety through Gadget customization.
We’ve added new Gadgets that expand customization options for the Air Trick, Collision, Item Hit, and Recovery builds, which had been underpowered compared to other Gadgets.

We also reviewed and adjusted the effects of certain support Gadgets that were difficult to use and added new support Gadgets as well. Our aim is to increase the range of options available to handle a wider variety of situations.
In addition, we’ve strengthened existing status-enhancement Gadgets overall to match the power level of the newly added Evolution Gadgets and Hyper Ring Engine.

Regarding Ring Engine, we’ve addressed an issue where starting position created slight advantages or disadvantages, while also adjusting the combined effect of equipping the two types of Ring Engines to prevent it from becoming too strong.
We will continue to make balance adjustments based on Gadget usage and win rates.

notes.title: Adjustment to Number of Rings at Start of Races

items.text: In all modes except Time Trial, the number of rings held at the start of a race has been standardized to 20. Up until Ver. 1.3, the number of rings at the start was adjusted based on starting position to mitigate advantages/disadvantages. However, for certain Ring-related Gadgets, such as Ring Engine and Low-Ring Speed Up, differences in starting ring counts affected how easily their effects could be triggered, which in some cases created advantages or disadvantages depending on starting position. We believe that in the current competitive environment, the impact of starting position has been reduced compared to before. Therefore, to ensure all racers begin under the same conditions regardless of starting position, the starting ring count has been set to 20 for everyone. There are no changes to Time Trial mode.

We have adjusted item balance so that powerful items, such as King Boom Boo, are more likely to appear based on the distance between racers. In addition, we have lifted the ban on Ring Engine and Hyper Ring Engine, which had previously been prohibited in Festivals.

In Ver. 1.3, differences in player skill and squad composition tended to result in larger gaps in match outcomes. In particular, Ring Engine and Hyper Ring Engine worked exceptionally well with the Super Team Dash’s invincibility effect and the team battle rule that prevents damage from teammates, allowing them to perform better than in other modes, such as World Match.
For this reason, their use had been restricted in Festivals, but based on the latest adjustments, we have decided to lift these restrictions.
We will continue to monitor and adjust balance in Festivals going forward.
Hyper Ring Engine
Fixed an issue where equipping only Hyper Ring Engine did not increase top speed. It will now properly increase top speed by 4 km/h.
Ring Engine + Hyper Ring Engine
The effects of combining the two Ring Engines have been adjusted as follows:
The top speed increase has been changed from +11 km/h to +9 km/h.
Fixed an issue where parameters were increasing excessively when Ring count was low.

We believe that combining the two Ring Engine Gadgets should offer performance that justifies the drawback of losing Rings every 0.5 seconds. However, in Version 1.3, this combination was performing better than intended, so we have reduced its effectiveness in this update.
Note: These changes will not be applied in Time Trial mode in consideration of their impact on World Rankings.
Crash Pads
The required slot cost has been reduced from 2 to 1.
Due to its relatively low win rate and limited standalone impact on race outcomes, this adjustment makes it easier to incorporate into a wider variety of builds.
Item Keeper
The Gadget effect will now activate against attacks from Dark Chao. When hit by Dark Chao, only empty item slots will be selected to reroll.
With this update, equipping this Gadget will prevent item loss caused by the red Warp Ring.
Note: This effect does not apply to forced item changes caused by Boost Frenzy.
Spin Drift/Drift Spinner Kit
The knockback effect against opponents has been strengthened.
This enhancement is especially noticeable when used while your Power stat is low.
Perfect Charge Boost
The duration of the speed boost triggered by a successful Perfect Charge has been slightly extended.
Friction Drift
Fixed an issue where slight deceleration could occur even when not drifting.
Quick Starter/Slow Starter
Increased the boost to all parameters from +10 to +20.
Super Quick Starter/Super Slow Starter
Increased the boost to all parameters from +20 to +60.
Tuner Gadgets
For all Tuner-type Gadgets, the parameter increases have been doubled:
When machine type does not match: +4 to +8
When machine type matches: +10 to +20
Note: There are no changes to parameter reductions.
Machine Kits

For all Machine Kits, parameter changes when the machine type matches have been adjusted. Previously, type matching applied both an increase (+20) and a decrease (-16). Going forward, only the increase (+20) will apply.
Ace Pilot Kit
When in Plane form, the increase to all parameters has been changed from +10 to +20.
Sea Dog Kit
When in Boat form, the increase to all parameters has been changed from +10 to +20.
Panel Combo Kit
The increases to Power and Handling have been raised from +4 to +8.

With Ver.1.3.1, we’re aiming to expand tactical variety through Gadget customization. We’ve added new Gadgets and adjusted existing gadgets to enable new playstyles, such as spending held Rings as a resource and gaining benefits by intentionally holding no Rings. Along with this, we’ve expanded Ring Gain Gadgets to further support these new strategies.

In Ver.1.2, strategies involving continuously gaining invincibility from Ultimate Charge had become dominant, so we shortened its invincibility duration. Since this change risked making comeback strategies from lower positions too strong, we also shortened the duration of the Drill item when used from higher positions.

In addition, because strategies for climbing from 4th–8th place still had challenges, we strengthened Collision Boost which serves as the starting point for tactics that move players up the ranks by colliding with other machines. Gadgets with similar effects, such as Ring Thief and Spin Drift, are also intended to become more effective through this adjustment.
We will continue balance adjustments based on Gadget usage rates and win rates.
Collision Boost/Power Machine Kit/Power Character Kit: Increased the duration of the Boost.
Previously, Collision Boost gave only a momentary speed boost and often failed to result in moving the racer up in position, so we adjusted it to make it more effective in overtaking other racers.
Crash Pads: Now triggers a Ring halving effect when hit by Ring Thief.
Ultimate Charge/Handling Machine Kit: Reduced the invincibility duration on a Level 4 Boost (from 3 seconds to 1.5 seconds.)

Ultimate Charge was designed as a racing‑focused Gadget that lets skilled players block attacks. However, as player skill has improved, it was enabling far more defensive opportunities than intended, making it difficult for other Gadgets to compete. This adjustment creates a clearer opening after activation, preserving the original idea of rewarding players’ skill in defending against attacks while still giving others more chances to counter.
Acceleration Character Kit: Removed the Mini Ring Thief from this kit.
Due to its high win rate and the increased customization options made possible by new Gadgets introduced Ver.1.3.1, we’ve reduced the number of effects bundled into this kit.
Inventory Swap: The Gadget Button UI will now gray out when swap is not possible.

Because using the Drill item made it too easy to jump to 1st place in the final lap, its effect duration has been shortened when the player is in 4th place or higher. Furthermore, the speed drop that occurs just before the Drill effect ends now happens earlier.
The Special Item Box had low competitive value, so its item lineup and appearance rates have been adjusted.
In some cases, Item Box Frenzy made it harder than normal to obtain items, so we adjusted box placement and behavior to make items easier to get.
Fixed an issue where desync caused by network conditions could unfairly allow other players to steal Item Boxes.

CPU racers were too likely to be in the lead early in a race, affecting player to player interaction, so we reduced their pace right after the start. (This does not apply to Rival races, such as those in Grand Prix.)
In Team Matches, ally CPUs were sometimes too slow and put players at a disadvantage, so we’ve increased their pace. (This does not apply to Rival races, such as those in Grand Prix.)

Powerful items had a greater impact than intended in Team Matches, so their drop rates were reduced. King Boom Boo, in particular, diminished the benefit of running in the lead outside the final lap, so its drop rate was lowered.

Super Team Boost made it too easy to return to the front, so its duration when far from 1st place was shortened. To increase the advantage of running in the lead outside the final lap, the duration of Super Team Boost when triggered in upper positions was increased.
Adjusted Ring and Item Box placement in PAC-VILLAGE & MAZE and Sky Road where there wasn’t enough risk reward balance. (These adjustments do not affect Time Trial.)
Expanded the Titles screen display to accommodate upcoming Festivals and Legend Competition Titles.
When playing as Tangle, her tail could sometimes block the camera and obscure the view of the course. We adjusted the tail’s movements so it no longer obstructs visibility.
In the Epic Games Store version, DirectInput controllers can now be used.
In World Match, Festivals, and Legend Competition lobbies, Fair Play Points will now decrease if a player intentionally disconnects or closes the application.
Fixed an issue where certain classic Sonic tracks would disappear from the Jukebox after performing specific actions. Updating to Ver.1.3.1 will automatically restore and unlock all affected tracks.
Fixed an issue where animations did not play correctly during the Festival award ceremony when using AI Racer skins.

notes.title: Warp Ring (Item) and Warp Ring Specialist (Gadget)

items.text: When using the Warp Ring item, an issue occurred where players could perform major course shortcuts or jump several positions at once. This has been fixed in the current version.

With this fix, the item can now be used more reliably in offline play and Friend Matches. However, because future course additions and online player behavior could still cause unexpected issues, the Warp Ring Item and the Warp Ring Specialist Gadget will not be usable in World Match, Festivals, or Legend Competition.
We sincerely apologize to players who were looking forward to using them. They will remain available for use against CPU opponents and in Friend Matches.

In Ver. 1.3.1, when a player is World Match Legend Rank 1, a Donpa Ticket reward that does not actually exist may appear on the rank gauge. This will be fixed in a future update. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
We’re committed to keeping the game fun, fair, and enjoyable for everyone, and we’ll continue improving it based on your feedback.

notes.title: Gadget Additions and Adjustments in Ver.1.2.0

items.text: Since launch, we’ve observed two common strategies emerge in online matches:
Using drift-type gadgets to maintain top positions.
Staying in 9th – 12th place and using item control gadgets to get powerful items late in the race and quickly jump to top positions.
Both strategies made it very difficult for those in 4th – 8th place to make a comeback.
Therefore, in Ver.1.2.0, we’ve added and strengthened support-type and item-type gadgets to make it easier to make comebacks from 4th – 8th place.
We will continue monitoring online gadget usage and win rates to adjust balance going forward.

Quick Recovery: Further reduced downtime after taking a hit.
Previously, Quick Recovery provided a large benefit when hit, but losing rings often led to lower final positions. The gadget has been adjusted to allow more mid-position endurance.
Acceleration Machine Kit: Recovery timing further reduced to align with Quick Recovery’s adjustments.
Wisp Chance UP: Reduced the influence on item probability.
Previously, Wisp Chance UP made it too easy to collect powerful items before the race’s end and aim for top positions. We’ve dialed this back a bit.
Invincible Start: Vehicles now flash just before the effect ends to make timing clearer.
Adjusted the appearance of Silver and Blaze’s AI skins and the color of Race Park rivals “Team Dimension,” as they could be mistaken for Invincible state.
For the eagle-eyed, the new color scheme is based on the “Turquoise Blue” aura Silver the Hedgehog emits when activating his abilities!

Improved machine handling after collisions with other machines in water areas.
Improved directional input detection to make it easier to use items in the intended direction while drifting.
Adjusted race communication to prioritize syncing information that affects race progression, improving correct reflection of Invincibility such as Ultimate Charge activation.
Strengthened anti-cheat measures for races and race results in online play such as World Match on PC.

With Patch Ver.1.2.0, we have strengthened our anti-cheat measures to ensure a fair and secure online environment. These improvements focus primarily on countering cheating behaviors that give players an unfair advantage in World Match and Time Trial.

If cheating activity continues to increase, we may be required to consider additional anti-cheat measures across a broader range of systems, depending on the situation. To ensure that all players can enjoy the game safely and fairly, we kindly ask for your continued cooperation in maintaining a fair and secure gameplay environment.
We will continue to listen to the community and make ongoing improvements to protect the player experience and ensure that the game remains a healthy and enjoyable environment for everyone.
Fixed Festival announcements showing old information before events began.
Fixed a bug where auto-acceleration failed to activate for several seconds after manual input.
Improved smoothness and visibility of left/right movement in item warning display.
Fixed a bug where Charge Dash would not activate when passing through Transform Rings in mid-air drift state using Dash type.
Fixed a bug where attacks from the “King Boom Boo” item could be avoided using Charge Jump or Handle Assist.
Fixed a bug where “King Boom Boo” item attacks in mid-air could cause fire pillar direction to be incorrect.
Fixed a bug where using the “Laser” item caused Dash type machine appearance to break at certain times.
Fixed a bug where using the “Boost” item obtained during Boost Frenzy at the exact end of Frenzy could make the item unusable.
Fixed a bug where using the “Tornado” item during Boost Frenzy could make items unusable until Frenzy ended.
Adjusted Dash Gate placement in Dash Gate Frenzy on certain courses where more gates than intended were placed.
Fixed a bug in course “Wonder Museum” where machines could get stuck in the Tornado.
Fixed a bug in course “Sky Road” or “Minecraft World” where using “Slicer” or “Homing Punch” when crossing Travel Rings or End Portals could cause incorrect tracking.
Fixed a bug in course “Steampunk City” where colliding from the side with ground where trains run could cause machines to sink into the ground.
Fixed a bug in course “White Cave” where using “Drill” in cave areas could cause machines to sink into the ground.
Fixed several other gameplay-related bugs.

issues.text: Certain tracks in the Jukebox may disappear after inputting specific commands.
This issue will be addressed in a future update.

In Ver. 1.3.1, when a player is World Match Legend Rank 1, a Donpa Ticket reward that does not actually exist may appear on the rank gauge. This will be fixed in a future update. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
We’re committed to keeping the game fun, fair, and enjoyable for everyone, and we’ll continue improving it based on your feedback.
